description: We are GeoSAR Explorers, a team passionate about space technology, Earth observation, and understanding changes on our planet using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. We are interested in satellite data analysis, remote sensing, AI/ML, and data visualization. We welcome enthusiastic team members with skills in Python, coding, Earth science, GIS, data processing, graphic design, and scientific communication who are eager to learn, collaborate, and innovate.
